name: SEDISH FHIR Pipeline
description: SQLMesh transform + loader that maps the EXTERNAL Consolidé consolidated_db to FHIR and pushes Patient identities to OpenCR (Phase 1; clinical to the SHR in Phase 2). Runs the sedish-fhir-pipeline image built locally by build-custom-images.sh from the public repo (or set PIPELINE_IMAGE to the GHCR tag to pull instead).
